# 所表示的边界与实际依存：在条件区域上的更新，只在区域覆盖其参与时是该步的更新；覆盖其所需且要求不收紧时保住自身支持，仍可侵蚀他者；遗漏其所需时，可以经自身的汲取失去自身支持 / A represented boundary against actual dependence: renewal over a region of conditions is renewal at the step where the region covers what the formation takes part in; covering what it requires, with requirements not tightening, it keeps its own support and can still undermine another; omitting what it requires, its own draw can lose its own support

## 主张 Claim

一个形成在 t 的事件在条件区域上更新（Web.RenewingOver），是指它活跃，并且该步保住它在区域中参与的每个条件上的每项依存。该步的更新就是在每个区域上的更新（Web.RenewingAt.over、Web.renewingAt_iff_over_all），在一个区域上的更新也是在它之内每个区域上的更新（Web.RenewingOver.narrow）。与形成的实际关系相比：区域覆盖它参与的每个条件时，在区域上的更新就是该步的更新（Web.RenewingOver.at）；区域覆盖它所需的每个条件、它的要求在该步不收紧时，在区域上更新的形成在该步之后被支持（Web.RenewingOver.keeps_own），但仍可侵蚀他者——Clearing 中清除者每步都在其资源（它唯一所需的条件）上更新，在第一步侵蚀，不在该步的更新之内（Clearing.renewing_over_resource）；区域遗漏它所需的一个条件时，它自身的汲取可以侵蚀它自身的依存——Omitted 中一个形成需要两个条件，在第零步在 false 上更新、要求不收紧，它也需要区域遗漏的 true，它对 true 的汲取侵蚀，在该步之后它不被支持（Omitted.loses_own；平衡、Acting、Taking 与 Dependent 都成立）。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。 / A formation's event at t is within renewal over a region of conditions (Web.RenewingOver) when it is active and the step keeps every dependence on every condition of the region it takes part in. Renewal at the step is renewal over every region (Web.RenewingAt.over, Web.renewingAt_iff_over_all), and renewal over a region is renewal over every region inside it (Web.RenewingOver.narrow). Compared with the formation's actual relations: over a region covering every condition it takes part in, renewal over the region is renewal at the step (Web.RenewingOver.at); over a region covering every condition it requires, where its requirements do not tighten across the step, a formation renewing over the region is supported after the step (Web.RenewingOver.keeps_own), yet it can still undermine another: in Clearing the clearer renews over its resource, the one condition it requires, at every step, undermines at step one and is not within renewal there (Clearing.renewing_over_resource); over a region omitting a condition it requires, its own draw can undermine its own dependence: in Omitted a formation requires two conditions, renews over false at step zero with requirements not tightening, also requires true, which the region omits, and its draw on true undermines, so after the step it is not supported (Omitted.loses_own; balance, Acting, Taking and Dependent all hold). No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

Canonical source: [Regions.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Regions.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 条件区域是陈述的参数；这里不模型一个中心怎样表示它。 / A region of conditions is a parameter of the statement; nothing here models how a center comes to represent it.
- keeps_own 需要区域覆盖形成在 t 所需的每个条件，并且其要求在该步不收紧。 / keeps_own needs the region to cover every condition the formation requires at t and its requirements not to tighten across the step.
- 比较只在一步上；多步的依存范围（供给其所需者的来源）不在比较之内。 / The comparison is at one step; dependence over several steps (the sources feeding what is required) is not compared.
- 离散的步（从第零步计）；自然数的水平、所需与数量。 / Discrete steps, counted from step zero; natural-number levels, needs and amounts.

Ren 写道：“recognizing the formation of the center is also with in the system, and the "boundary" is also with in the same cognitive system”，又写道自我的“imagined boundary”“it is also cognitive construct that's materialistic”。作者的读法（AI 论证，待 Ren）：一个条件区域读作一个中心所表示的边界，形成实际参与与所需的条件读作它的实际依存。一个中心的边界可以覆盖其所需而不覆盖其参与，于是保住自身而侵蚀他者；也可以遗漏其所需，于是经自身的汲取失去自身支持；只有覆盖其参与的边界给出该步的更新。这里没有模型中心怎样形成或表示边界，区域在展开之外没有地位。这为路线 (b)（P40）准备了比较：“应当”是中心在其所表示的边界与其实际依存一致时所做的；那条路线尚未开始。读法与名称是 AI 的。 / Ren wrote that “recognizing the formation of the center is also with in the system, and the "boundary" is also with in the same cognitive system”, and of the self's “imagined boundary” that “it is also cognitive construct that's materialistic”. The author's reading (an AI argument, pending Ren): a region of conditions reads as the boundary a center represents, and the conditions a formation actually takes part in and requires as its actual dependence. A center's boundary can cover what it requires and not what it takes part in, so it keeps itself and undermines another; or it can omit what it requires, so its own draw loses its own support; only a boundary covering what it takes part in gives renewal at the step. Nothing here models how a center forms or represents a boundary, and the region has no status outside the unfolding. This prepares a comparison for route (b) (P40), on which “should” is what a center does once its represented boundary matches what it actually depends on; that route has not begun. The reading and the names are the AI's.
